alternatives_rejected.why: A diskio z of about 1e19 points to a near-zero-variance baseline, not a real disk fault. If disk I/O were the cause, currencyservice's own span self-time would rise, but it is flat at 0.14->0.13ms (E2, E3).
Memory rose 457.7% (E3), but currencyservice's own self-time did not degrade (0.92x, E2). That is unlike real memory pressure; the latency is only seen by callers on the inbound path (E2).
The frontend-external error spike (E1) is downstream of the currencyservice inbound latency increase (E2). currencyservice itself shows no errors (E2) and only routine info logs (E4).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove any network delay injected on currencyservice's interface or pod network, such as a tc netem rule or a chaos experiment. Then confirm that inbound p50 latency returns to about 5ms and that frontend errors subside.
